preserved_invariants: the frozen W0-W18 core remains authoritative; the merged product packages (P0-P14) are consumed read-only through their public exports only — no internal package mutation

every product journey is driven through merged public exports behind deterministic reference adapters/bodies/executors (no real GitHub APIs, no real providers, no real deployment targets, no network, no ambient time/random)

zero external dependencies: workspace:* + the existing toolchain only (typescript ^5.5.0, vitest ^3.0.0, @types/node ^22.10.0 — the P6/P9/P13 carve-out); pnpm-lock.yaml is byte-identical on the branch (workspace deps carry no registry resolution)

exact-revision evidence links: every consequential artifact (source revision, decision record, evaluation result, deployment record) carries an exact content-addressed revision link — no fabricated HEALTHY/COMPLETE

uncertainty visible: every journey's terminal record surfaces retained uncertainty (SIMULATED markers, reference-mode notes, QUALITATIVE + UNQUANTIFIED applicability, NOT_YET_CONNECTED provider statuses, R19 penalty demonstrated)
the §7 device-optional pin: the flagship journey completes WITHOUT any user-online tick after kick-off (cloud ticks only); cloud work orders never consult device presence
the §10 completion discipline: a worker/body may report completion but cannot certify mission success by itself (independent evaluation is the only completion gate)
the §12 brownfield discipline: competing architecture hypotheses never collapse to a single winner; ambiguity is retained honestly

the §13 non-negotiable boundaries: harnesses cannot redefine SOS semantics; bodies cannot grant themselves authority; LLM output is never authoritative evidence or authorization; the broker cannot silently escalate authority; Redis/queues cannot become semantic authorities; provider outages remain UNKNOWN/UNAVAILABLE where appropriate; demo fixtures are never production state
ASK is first-class: candidate + assurance + experiment + ASK is a typed decision discipline (ACT / ROLLBACK / ASK / REJECT) — never silent gating
promotion + rollback assert revision-level state transitions with evidence per action via the merged action/state surfaces (never by mutating state directly)
package composition + self-evolution assert the ecology surfaces update as DATA (learned records), never by writing package internals
history asserts the full timeline is queryable end-to-end (decision -> action -> evidence -> state), including after rollback
the local-companion/IDE/browser journey asserts the same flagship flow is reachable through the P11 surfaces (reference bridges)
